content.short: Authentication tool used to write data utilizing transactional metadata or smart contracts to the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
Although blockchain is quickly becoming mainstream, it remains a nascent technology in many industrial organizations, as well as for small businesses and individuals. CertifiedDataNow allows these organizations and users to seamlessly write to the Cardano blockchain. Use cases may include, writing to the Cardano blockchain for “Proof of Identity”, “Proof of Ownership”, “Proof of Existence” or mission-critical data in the form of smart contracts or transactional metadata.

The emergence of blockchain technology coupled with a lack of skill set and difficult ease-of-use makes it not easily accessible to everyone regardless of person, industry, or organization. Users will have several options, an easy web browser interface for individuals or a backend system for organizations or industrial use.

Since hash values are non-reversible, and easily stored on the Cardano blockchain there are many use cases for utilizing representative hashes for any file, folder, or data - such as documents, images, and additionally compressed files – such as large data sets, and encrypted files. The proposed system can be incorporated into or alongside smart contracts adding further functionality and complexity.

Cardano’s transactional metadata storage, low transaction fees, and supportive community make it a prime candidate allowing integration and use, bridging the gap between industry and blockchain. CertifiedDataNow hopes to make the Cardano blockchain as accessible as the internet.
